setup: You are adding the two-digit numbers [[a]] and [[b]].

steps.say: Start with the ones column: [[ones_a]] and [[ones_b]].
If those reach 10 or more, the extra ten is a carry — it adds one to the tens column on the left, and the ones column keeps only what is left over.
Now the tens column, with that carry added, gives the tens digit of [[sum]].
